# AOS 2.3.4

Self-hosted Animate On Scroll JavaScript and stylesheet, copied unmodified from the published package. The MIT license is included in LICENSE.

- Source and documentation: https://github.com/michalsnik/aos
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/aos/v/2.3.4

jsfile/motion.js adds animation attributes only when the library loads and the visitor allows motion. Plain HTML remains readable without JavaScript.
